class ReserveFloor(TypedDict):
    """One reserveFloors entry; see docs/data-model/02-worker-pool-and-dispatch.md."""

    remainingPct: float
    protectedClasses: list[str]
    rerouteHeld: bool
    pausePct: float
    releaseBeforeResetHours: float
    active: bool
    nearCap: bool
    measurement: QuotaMeasurement | None
    weeklyMeasurement: QuotaMeasurement | None
    weeklyMeasurementReason: str | None
    reason: str
    paused: bool
    released: bool
    mode: str
    nextResetAt: str | None
    releaseAt: str | None
    releaseKnown: bool
    releaseStatus: str
    # Fleet status adds counts; an unavailable ledger read emits null.
    heldCount: NotRequired[int | None]
    pauseHeldCount: NotRequired[int | None]

def weekly_evidence(state: Mapping[str, Any], credential: str) -> tuple[dict, str | None]:
    """Shared weekly reader; diagnostics never substitute short-window evidence.

    Selection policy still checks status alone. Shape diagnostics are evidence,
    not additional admission conditions.
    """
    path = f"reserveFloors.{credential}"
    prefix = "quota_reserve.snapshot: "
    floor = state.get(credential)
    if not isinstance(floor, Mapping):
        return {}, prefix + path + " missing/invalid object"
    weekly = floor.get("weeklyMeasurement")
    if not isinstance(weekly, dict):
        reason = floor.get("weeklyMeasurementReason")
        if "weeklyMeasurement" in floor and weekly is None:
            label = (
                "unavailable"
                if reason in ("no-weekly-window", "measurement-unavailable")
                else "missing/invalid reason"
            )
            return (
                {},
                prefix
                + path
                + f".weeklyMeasurement=null; {path}.weeklyMeasurementReason={reason!r} ({label})",
            )
        return {}, prefix + path + ".weeklyMeasurement missing/invalid object"
    status = weekly.get("status")
    if status != "measured":
        return (
            weekly,
            prefix
            + path
            + f".weeklyMeasurement.status={status!r}; {path}.weeklyMeasurementReason={floor.get('weeklyMeasurementReason')!r}",
        )
    for field in ("percentRemaining", "percentConsumed"):
        value = weekly.get(field)
        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
            return weekly, prefix + path + f".weeklyMeasurement.{field} missing/invalid number"
    return weekly, None
